images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: standalone high-resolution concept art for an original educational mobile-first game. Request 2048x2048 pixels or the highest native resolution available.
Game: Clover Peekaboo (TD-02). Genre/mechanic: Peekaboo hide and reveal.
Primary scene and action: A giant four-leaf clover fills the screen and a fawn's ears poke out from behind it. One tap anywhere folds the leaves open to reveal the fawn's happy face as a warm voice says peekaboo.
Learning objective expressed by the actual interaction: Object permanence, waiting, joy of surprise.
World: a soft clover meadow on the planet Raya at the foot of a short, slender white tower, untouched nature all around, in the shared Links universe.
Art direction: Gameplay. Show the playable board or interaction from a readable overhead or side camera. Use crisp 2D shapes and an inviting hand-painted finish. The mechanic is the hero; keep environmental detail at the edges.
Identity: adorable, intelligent and welcoming. Soft rounded shapes, very large touch targets and calm colors for small children. An original tiny Links guide may appear: a soft round creature with a coral-red left eye, sky-blue right eye and gentle curved smile. A white Orbi sphere with coral-red and sky-blue eyes may float nearby. Untouched clover meadows, natural woods and a few distant slender white Chord towers. Toddler mode shows ONLY nonhuman round creatures, wild animals and Orbi spheres. No humans, humanoid children, human faces, human hands or human fingers anywhere. References to a child mean the off-screen player. Show touch interactions as a round creature paw or a soft circular tap ripple. Keep the main mechanic unmistakable.
Constraints: one complete standalone image, no collage, no contact sheet, no inset panels. Original characters, compositions, boards and objects; do not copy existing games' art or trade dress. No violence, weapons, money, shop, advertising, logos, watermarks, or written title. Use pattern and shape as well as color. Educational visuals are concept proposals, not validated scientific diagrams. Preserve physical plausibility where relevant. Beautiful deliberate composition and readable large interaction targets.
Mandatory style: a flat 2D storybook game illustration, with bold clean outlines, simple cel-shaded color areas and a restrained printed-paper texture. Readable graphic shapes seen overhead or side-on. Absolutely no 3D rendering, glossy plastic shading, photographic lighting, realistic depth of field or photorealism. This is the graphic illustration alternative to the separate 3D concept.
images.encoding: WebP quality 92, original pixel dimensions; no upscaling
